# dify_plugins (Data Source)

Lists all plugins installed in the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all plugins installed in the workspace.
data "dify_plugins" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plugins` (Attributes List) List of installed plugins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins))

<a id="nestedatt--plugins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Plugin category (e.g. `model`, `tool`).
- `identifier` (String) Versioned plugin identifier (e.g. `langgenius/openai:0.3.8@<sha256>`).
- `plugin_id` (String) Plugin ID (e.g. `langgenius/openai`).
- `source` (String) Installation source.
- `version` (String) Installed version.
